verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a live llms.txt at better-auth.com (HTTP 200), and doc pages are served as raw markdown (.md endpoints), which agents can ingest directly. First-party docs also describe a hosted remote MCP server that gives MCP-capable clients such as Cursor, Codex and Claude Code documentation search, examples and setup help. Missing for 10: the probe excerpt is truncated, so the llms.txt content's depth is unverified, and there is no independent report of agents using these resources in practice.
